name: Len Ainsworth
forbes_bio: Len Ainsworth founded Aristocrat Leisure, the world's second-biggest gaming-machine company, in 1953. He stepped aside in 1994 after a cancer scare.
He gave his large stake in Aristocrat Leisure to his seven sons and ex-wife more than 20 years ago; he's entitled to some proceeds if they sell.
He started a similar company, Ainsworth Game Technology, the following year at age 72.
He stepped down as executive director at age 94 after selling his majority stake to Austrian gaming giant Novomatic.
He signed the giving pledge in March 2017.

name: Wu Zhenxing
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2023); Forbes annual (2021-2022); Hurun Global (2021-2023); Hurun China (2020-2022)
forbes_bio: Wu Zhenxing is a vice president of Foshan Haitian Flavouring and Food, a soy sauce supplier maker based in southern China.

name: Xiong Xiaochuan
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2001-2023); Hurun Global (2023-2026); Hurun China (2023-2026)
forbes_bio: Xiong Xiaochuan chairs Chinese medical device and personal protective equipment supplier MeHow Innovative.
MeHow went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in October 2022.
Xiong worked for Sichuan Changhong Electric early in his career, before earning an MBA from the University of Warwick.

name: Lou Jing
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2015-2026)
forbes_bio: Lou Jin is chairman and CEO of 3SBIO Inc, a biopharmaceutical company.
The company first went public on the Nasdaq in 2007 before privatizing in 2013. It listed again in Hong Kong in 2015.
The company's main research and development centers are in Shenyang, Shanghai, Shenzhen and Hangzhou.

name: Axel Stawski
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2017-2025); Hurun Global (2020); Wikidata (2021)
forbes_bio: Real estate billionaire Axel Stawski founded Stawski Partners in 1973.
The company owns six office buildings and three condos in Manhattan.
He sold a residential tower project in Queens' Long Island City for $200 million in March 2022.
Stawski was born in post-war Germany to Jewish parents who both survived the Holocaust.
He immigrated to the U.S. in 1971 to attend New York University.
forbes_facts: Stawski is a board member of the American Society for Yad Vashem, which supports the Yad Vashem World Holocaust Remembrance Center in Jerusalem.
Before emigrating to the U.S. with his family in 1971, Stawski's father was a real estate developer in West Germany, focusing on shopping centers.

name: Horst-Otto Gerberding
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2024); Forbes annual (2021-2022); Hurun Global (2021-2025)
forbes_bio: Horst-Otto Gerberding owns 5% of Symrise AG, one of the world's largest makers of ingredients for fragrances, flavors, nutrients and cosmetics.
Symrise resulted from the 2003 merger of Dragoco and Haarmann & Reimer.
Founded in 1919 by Carl-Wilhelm Gerberding in Holzminden, Germany, Dragoco started out producing formulations for perfume and soap.
Horst-Otto serves on the advisory board of Symrise, which employs more than 10,000 people and has annual revenue of around $4 billion.
He was also majority owner and chairman of the advisory board of Gottfried Friedrichs GmbH & Co. KG, a fish-products company based in Hamburg. It closed with no buyer in 2023.
forbes_facts: He holds a BA in Business Administration from Western Washington University in Bellingham, WA.
Together with his wife, Kirsten, he founded Courage - Die Gerberding Stiftung, a foundation focused on youth education, sports and civic engagement.

name: Sunder Genomal
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2025); Forbes annual (2022); Hurun Global (2022); Hurun India (2017-2019)
forbes_bio: Sunder Genomal runs Page Industries, one of the biggest licensees in the world for underwear maker Jockey.
The Bangalore-headquartered Page Industries is also the exclusive Indian licensee of swimwear brand Speedo.
Genomal set up Page Industries in 1994 with the aim of bringing Jockey to India.
His son Shamir is the company's deputy managing director.
While Sunder is a U.K. citizen, his brother  Ramesh, who is also a billionaire, is a citizen of Cyprus.
